title: Give the Mark III its day: the learn setting in the bot brain, and Robot Mk III in the shop
tier_reason: Gameplay code behind both suites; git reverts it. The price waits on Q-96 but the row can land with the recommended 800.
ask: Per docs/design/06: a 'learn' config branch in BotBrain.step that builds the observation, samples the policy, executes one step or one water-here through the gateway, wakes once a second (extra.wake = tick + SimClock.RATE), and parks when its meter is 0; a bot_mk3 catalogue row (program 'policy', configs [], default_config 'learn') added to ORDER; the machine panel showing days practised and yesterday's score in numbers (Q-97's floor).
first_action: Add CONFIG_LEARN to bot_brain.gd and the _learn() branch after the mark-1's page check; add the bot_mk3 row to systems/machine_defs.gd and to ORDER; extend test_mark_one_robot's catalogue assertions with the third row; then the panel numbers.
source_message: CEO, 2026-09-09, chief of staff session: v0.2.1 is the Mark III, the robot that learns by reinforcement (P-14).
